articleTitle: Unified Butterfly for NTT in Post-Quantum Cryptography Algorithm CRYSTALs-Kyber
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: Quantum computing is a fast developing technology that puts the presently implemented cryptosystems at risk. National Institute of Standards and Technology announced CRSYTALs-Kyber as a standard after Post Quantum Cryptography competition. Kyber is a Lattice-based Cryptography algorithm that uses Number Theoretic transform technique to perform polynomial multiplication. To make NTT efficient, a compact and high-performance butterfly unit is required. In this work we have presented an FPGA based pipelined butterfly structure by incorporating a multiplier-free and low-complex Barrett reduction algorithm. Consequently, our design achieves an 18.2% increase in maximum operating frequency and 32.9% improvement in hardware efficiency.

articleTitle: Blockchain Sharding Model to Increase The Efficiency of Waste Management Processes Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: The waste management system is a series of activities that include collection, transportation, processing, recycling, and disposal of waste with the aim of managing waste effectively and environmentally friendly. The goal is to reduce the negative impact of waste on human health and the environment and maximize the reuse of materials that still have utility value. Several studies have attempted to improve the efficiency of waste processing systems based on blockchain technology. This research highlights the inefficiency of waste processing with conventional blockchain technology, where each waste management transaction must go through a validation process by all participants in the blockchain network. The validation process with a very large number of participants involved in waste processing is irrelevant if using conventional blockchain technology. So this research offers the application of a blockchain sharding model for national-scale waste management. The validation process is carried out in layers at the district, provincial, and national levels so as to increase transaction efficiency on the blockchain network. The research uses a qualitative approach through a literature review to study the weaknesses of waste processing with blockchain technology and offers solutions by implementing the blockchain sharding concept. The research output is in the form of a proposed model; use case diagrams and simulations with Hyperledger.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of AI -Enabled, Remote Vitals Monitoring System Using LoRaWAN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: The availability of low cost biomedical sensors and their integration with rapidly growing internet of things technologies has sparked research and developments in the field of Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) providing numerous opportunities to expand healthcare services to personal level. Furthermore, the availability of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools can potentially customize the healthcare solutions to meet the individual needs by providing the remote data collection, analysis and prediction capabilities. Such AI-enabled IoMT systems can be used for continuous patient monitoring and timely medical intervention. In this paper, we present the design on our AI-enabled IoMT system and its implementation for remote monitoring of patient's vitals including heart rate, blood pressure, and oxygen saturation. We implemented our IoMT system using LoRa W Anas communication technology which is a Low Power Wide Area Network technology, capable of providing low power, long range communication among IoMT devices to collect real-time data for patient's vitals. The low power consumption and long communication range of LoRa W Antechnology, enables scalable and cost effective deployment of the developed system. Moreover, we have also tested the performance of the developed prototype in terms of data accuracy, energy efficiency, and real-time processing capabilities.

articleTitle: Free Space Optical Communication Using Principles of Quantum Mechanics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: It all begun by the early 1970s through, the work of Stephen Wiesner and Gilles Brassard, who introduced the concept of quantum conjugate coding, and it has now stretched to a level where today's agile communication systems constitute a substantial challenge for data security and safety. A number of research has been performed to achieve secure communication among legitimate parties in which QKD (Quantum Key Distribution) is prominent. Quantum Key Distribution (QKD), also called Quantum Cryptography, enables two communicating parties to share secret cryptographic keys with security that is theoretically guaranteed by the laws of quantum mechanics, assuming ideal conditions. However, practical implementations may be vulnerable to certain attacks, and the security of QKD can be compromised by imperfections in hardware, side-channel attacks, or limitations in real-world setups. In a practical QKD setup, two stations send and receive encoded quantum particles and some classical information. The most rudimentary and well-known QKD protocol is BB84, developed by Bennet and Brassard in 1984. We have developed the simulation and achieved the secret shared key with and without an intruder.

articleTitle: Urban Pluvial Flood Prediction Using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: Urban pluvial flooding causes threats to human lives, economy, infrastructure, and ecosystems around the world, particularly in developing countries. Pakistan is among those developing countries that have become vulnerable to urban flooding due to global warming, climate change risks, rapid urbanization, and the occurrence of extreme and unusual rainfall events in the monsoon season. To effectively mitigate the adverse effects of pluvial flooding, there is a pressing need for an advanced and accurate predictive model that is capable of predicting urban pluvial flooding. The aim of this research is to utilize the potential of machine learning (ML) techniques and algorithms to accurately predict the occurrence of urban pluvial flooding, for this study we have worked on the monsoon rainfall data of multiple cities of Sindh province in Pakistan. We made an attempt to use multiple ML models especially logistic regression (LR), random forest (RF), k nearest neighbor (KNN), and support vector machine (SVM) to propose the best and accurate predictive model. The developed models were evaluated and assessed using various performance evaluation metrics which includes accuracy, recall, precision and F1 score. The best among proposed models was created using LR which achieved an accuracy of 97%, while the accuracy of other models which were created using SVM, KNN and RF were 96%, 93%, and 92% respectively.

articleTitle: Implementation of Differential Privacy for Enhancing Data Privacy in Wearable Fitness Trackers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: The availability of fitness wearable as devices has gradually been on the rise has made the monitoring of individual health, and frequent routines a thing a further degree, but at the same time making privacy questions at the same time. The leakage of information related to wearable fitness tracking devices are rather frequent, it puts personal information at risk of being misused, identity loss and theft, and money loss. This research addresses the important question of how to protect users' and audience's personal data of wearable fitness technology by examining a secure and privacy-conscious methods, with a special reference to Differential Privacy (DP). DP provides providing a mathematical context which guarantees data integrity information while revealing new ideas that can be used without violating the privacy of the participants personal information. This study also explores the usage of DP mechanisms, namely Laplacian and Gaussian mechanisms developed for analysing data collected from wearable fitness tracking devices to maintain privacy at the same time serving the purpose of utility of data. Key questions examined knowledge areas include; Inferences from fitness tracker information and the consequences of utilisation of DP mechanisms. The analysis demonstrates that Laplace mechanism for sleep data is effective slight oscillations from the initial values, thus enabling the preservation of their traditional meanings. The proposed filters enhance the quality of the dataset and its statistically related attributes as well. Similarly, thus, the Gaussian mechanism contributes to data accuracy with minimal variations. Through further analysis, this work shows that Differential Privacy mechanisms can accurately balance privacy and use of data for users and manufacturers.

articleTitle: Disaster Resilient Cellular Network: Challenges and Requirements
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: The advancement of cellular networks has transformed wireless communications, enabling a vast array of applications and catalyzing transformative technologies across various sectors. However, the resilience of these critical infrastructures has been tested by natural catastrophes, weather-related disturbances, and malevolent human activities. These events have often led to massive failures that hindered the seamless functioning of cellular networks. In this paper, our primary objective is to explore the impact of various catastrophic events on cellular networks and discuss recent techniques that have been proposed to improve network resiliency. We initiated by investigating the protocols that have been implemented in recent years to address such events. Subsequently, we have discussed reactive measures involving two different technologies strategically deployed on a large-scale network aiming to significantly enhance network resilience. The network resilience mechanism presented in this paper encompasses all communication infrastructures and standards. It also efficiently manages heterogeneous networks demonstrating benefits in terms of network stability, scalability, energy saving and improved data transfer rates and throughput. Through these concrete efforts, we strive to ensure that cellular networks can withstand and recover from various catastrophicevents, thereby providing users with reliable and uninterrupted communication services.

articleTitle: Safe-Campus: Leveraging AI for Advanced Surveillance and Security Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: The primary concern faced by any institution frequented by the public daily is the breach of safety, security and compliance standards upheld by the institution. While nearly all organizations implement security systems on premises, it is often highly dependent on manual surveillance, an inadequate approach, the outcomes of which are limited by delayed response times, inconsistent monitoring and lack of real-time analysis. Conventional surveillance systems need to be redesigned to integrate a more intelligent security systems infrastructure, upgrading to accommodate for the evolving requirements of contemporary institutions. In this paper we propose an AI based solution; “Safe-Campus”. We have developed a framework for real-time data analysis of the CCTV footage, that takes into account safety concerns and attempts to mitigate them by leveraging artificial intelligence models, utilizing object detection, anomaly detection and generate an alert on time to provide an automated solution. By use of this cutting-edge technology, we can ensure enhanced safety, security and compliance regulations taking the realm of surveillance architecture beyond the limitations of response delays, inconsistent monitoring issues and insufficient real-time analysis. The successful implementation of this system could serve as a benchmark for other in-house systems.

articleTitle: Towards Robust Quantum Communication: A Taxonomy of Vulnerabilities and Attacks over a decade in Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) promises secure communication by leveraging quantum principles. Although there has been significant theoretical research conducted in the field of QKD. However, it is still an emerging frontier in the realm of practical implementation. The absence of standardization exposes several vulnerabilities in both quantum and classical spectrums. In this paper, we present a comprehensive review of the Q KD vulnerabilities and attack models published from the past decade and classify them within a taxonomy. By bridging theory and practice, we aim to improve the practical security of Q KD against threats and pave the way for robust quantum communication.

articleTitle: Early Stage Breast Cancer Prediction Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: Breast cancer is the most frequent cause of death in women, being the second leading cause of cancer deaths worldwide. Early detection is a good remedy hence we have devised a Computer Aided Detection (CAD) method to detect not only cancer but also the type and stage of cancer for early and immediate treatments and classify them into four classes namely benign mass, benign calcification, malignant mass and malignant calcification. Our CAD system is based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for image classification with ResN etSO Architecture. The data is obtained from an open-source database TCIA (The Cancer Imaging Archive) and the dataset was DDSM (CBIS-DDSM). Training on a large dataset gives high accuracy but due to limited image data we used data augmentation techniques to create around 8,000 images from 2,400 images. The image preprocessing steps include DICOM to PNG conversion, resizing, and pectoral muscle removal. The accuracy is 81 % on the CBIS-DDSM dataset.

articleTitle: Examiti: Revolutionizing Exam Paper Creation and Quality Evaluation Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: Teachers often spend a significant amount of time and effort creating and managing exams to meet Outcome-Based Education (OBE) standards and ensure the quality of examination papers, which can take away from their primary focus on educating students. Examiti is an innovative platform that automates the examination management process, utilizing AI-powered evaluation through the Lama 2.0 model to assess the quality, difficulty, and originality of exam papers. The platform allows educators to categorize and store questions in a dynamic question bank facilitating quick paper assembly. Its reactive editor simplifies document formatting so that teachers can concentrate on producing high-quality content. This paper outlines the development and testing of Examiti, highlighting its multi-layered testing strategy and user-centered design, which provide a reliable, scalable, and easy-to-use exam management system. Examiti possesses the capability to significantly improve the exam experience for students in educational institutions.

articleTitle: Construction of a Quantum Random Number Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: Quantum random number generators (QRNG) are the prime source of randomness, by exploiting the unpredictable nature of Quantum mechanics QRNG aims to provide a string of completely random utterly unpredictable numbers. QRNGs are crucial for cryptography, scientific calculation, simulation, and many more real-world applications. Our Optical Quantum Random Number Generator (OQRNG) utilizes a high-speed pulsating laser, a Polarizing beam splitter (PBS), photodetectors, and advanced signal processing units that capture and digitize random photon intensity forming the raw random bit stream. This technique is famously known as Branching Path Technique. After that, we implement rigorous testing that encompasses the statistical randomness tests developed by National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) to ensure the guaranteed ran-domness meets security standards. A user-friendly Graphic user interface (GUI) simplifies interaction with the QRNG allowing the user to configure device settings, monitor system performance, and securely extract random numbers. Our findings help us demonstrate the superiority of QRNGs over classical random number generators, and highlight the potential of photon-based QRNGs and their environmentally friendly and efficient random number generation.

articleTitle: Optimizing Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) Attack Detection Techniques on Software Defined Network (SDN) Using Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: Distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks refer to a category of cyber attacks in which an attacker attempts to overwhelm a resource, such as a server, destination, or bandwidth through various means. This is usually done by either flooding the traffic or sending a heavy crunching job to exhaust the CPU or heavy amounts of data to pileup the storage. By the rise of virtualization and cloud technologies, networks have also evolved from hardware to a piece of software which virtualizes the operation of a network equipment. This virtualization is termed as a Software Defined Network (SDN). Due to the sheer impact of cyberattacks on the performance of networks, the study of DDoS attacks on SDN is vital in the present era. Contemporary approaches such as machine learning and deep learning have proven to be effective in attack detection of DDoS in SDNs. In this paper, a preliminary analysis is carried out to study the impact of feature selection to increase the throughput and response time of Machine learning techniques in detection of DDoS attacks on SDN. The results indicate that feature selection, when applied to machine learning algorithms, is an effective approach for DDoS attack detection in SDNs.

articleTitle: SSS: Investigating Secure Scalable Solutions for Blockchain (An SLA Scenario)
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: Blockchain has been gaining attraction in a variety of industrial domains because of its security, decentralization, and transparency, however, it is believed that still thorough investigation is lacking in terms of how the level of difficulty in consensus algorithms affects the throughput and scalability of blockchain systems. An effort has been made to investigate this gap by performing a detailed empirical investigation with varying difficulty levels of PoW (Proof of Work) consensus algorithm using an SLA (Service Level Agreement) based scenario. It takes into consideration the impact of the number of nodes in our proposed system, the size of individual blocks, their speed of generation, and the rate of confirmation of transactions into the block of the main consensus chain. SLA-based transactions have been injected into the permissioned blockchain. The empirical analysis in the paper demonstrates that the rate of the number of transactions decreases as the system operates under a high level of difficulty with some degradation of performance.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Quantum Safe Virtual Private Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: The start of quantum computing poses a significant security threat to the existing Virtual Private Networks that reinforce secure communication on the internet. Quantum computers have the potential to break widely used encryption algorithms, such as RSA and ECC, by efficiently solving complex mathematical problems. Therefore, there is an urgent need to develop and analyze quantum-safe alternatives for Virtual Private Networks. This thesis embarks on a journey of quantum-safe algorithms and how we used to design and implement them to make a quantum-safe VPN environment, aiming to path towards a secure digital future. In this thesis, we have designed a quantum-safe VPN and then analyzed how it works compared to traditional VPNs. We used NIST's algorithms: Dilithium3 for digital signatures.

articleTitle: Real-Time Detection of Cyber Threats via Dark Web Traffic Analysis Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: Cyberattack strategies have advanced over the past few years, making it harder to defend against them even when countermeasures are employed. The ability to forecast cyberattacks, take adequate safeguards, and effectively use cyber intelligence that enables these activities is essential for handling this scenario successfully. This work will focus on the incoming packets from the dark web and propose an approach to extracting data that includes important information or intelligence from the dark web, characterizing each packet's information using machine learning, deep learning, and identifying upcoming threats. By utilizing an extreme gradient boosting architecture, we suggest a new dark net traffic analysis and network management framework to automate the detection of malicious content in real-time. Intelligent computer forensic tool to analyze network traffic and debug malware. Identification of encrypted and real-time traffic We provide a model that can carry out multiple tasks, like recognizing attacks and categorizing dark web packets, established on extreme gradient boosting decision trees and convolutional neural networks. The sophisticated solution is suggested to remove skill and effort barriers that prohibit many enterprises from properly securing their most crucial assets by automating the criminal intent dark net identification procedure. This strategy will enable us to comprehend the new cyber threats and, in the interim, to respond appropriately to hostile activity. This will enable us to advance in terms of security.

articleTitle: SmogMaster- LIDAR-Enhanced Driving Assistance for Beyond Visibility in Dense Fog
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: This paper introduces “SmogMaster: Your Smart Driving Companion, “ the Visual Editorial Quality Assurance, an intelligent Smart Driving Assistant System (SDAS) in areas with high foggy weather affected by heavy fog. This system is installed with a RP Lidar Al sensor, camera, and the Yolov8s model for real-time feedback. By using Lidar technology, the system identifies obstacles and objects in order to create some kind of a point of cloud, which helps to avoid collisions and accidents. The Yolov8s model is equipped with a camera to identify the objects/obstacles and to calculate the distance between preprocessors using real part identification barrier to prevent accidents. SmogM aster is specially designed to be installed/implemented in the areas which are heavily affected by fog to provide accurate and timely heavy smog warnings and thus making it safer to drivers. This paper includes the development, implementation, and testing of SmogMaster, demonstrating that it has an order of magnitude lower risk acceptance potential to low-visibility accidents. The results demonstrate that The range of systems the SmogMaster helps discriminate against drivers, raising the bar for intelligent driving systems in unfavorable weather.

articleTitle: Recommender System F or Educational and Professional Growth
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: This study presents a course recommendation system that uses machine learning algorithms, such as deep learning, to enhance the reliability and individuality of courses. The system uses data from Peking University's Open Research Data Platform, which contains three main tables: Course Information, Student Information, and Course Selection. The data is combined into a single dataset through joining, and the system transforms education level and course type into numerical features. The model building phase involves developing a neural network with embedding layers for students and courses, LSTM, GRU, and MLP layers. An attention mechanism is also incorporated to improve the accuracy of the model. Hyper parameters are tuned with Optuna to find the best combination of hyper parameters for improved performance.The model's evaluation is evaluated using AUC (Area under the curve) and logarithmic loss. The system can recommend courses even to new students without previous course records. The cold-start problem is addressed by integrating Collaborative Filtering (CF) and Content-Based Filtering (CBF), allowing the system to recommend courses even to new students without prior course records.Future improvements include better machine learning algorithms, such as deep reinforcement learning, and real-time student usage. The system's capabilities are expanded to recommend other educational content, such as books, articles, videos, and learning modes, facilitating personalized learning and helping students achieve their targets. The findings suggest future directions for applying advanced machine learning and deep learning methods in educational recommender systems. The system is highly accurate, user-friendly, and has been proven effective in improving education quality.

articleTitle: CyberCure - Malware Defense System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: In today's world, the rise of cyber threats highlights the need for solutions that protect sensitive information and uphold system integrity. CyberCure, that is Pakistan's first malware defense system, is designed to meet the demands of cybersecurity by employing a comprehensive and adaptable approach to computer security. With the use of machine learning algorithms, signature based detection, and behavioral analysis, CyberCure offers a powerful defense that responds to both new and emerging threats. CyberCure offers an array of protective features, including four types of scans: quick scan, deep scan, removable device scan, and directory scan. Each scan type is specifically tailored to address different security needs, allowing users to select the proper level of analysis based on the perceived threat or the depth of investigation needed. Along With these scan options is a quarantine feature that safely isolates suspicious files, giving users the ability to remove, recover, or allow files based on a personalized risk assessment. Designed with a simple interface, users of all technical backgrounds can manage their security settings without sacrificing system performance. By improving resource usage, the software minimizes system slowdowns, allowing for a seamless balance between robust protection and everyday functionality. This paper presents CyberCure as a potential meaningful change in strengthening cybersecurity defenses, both within Pakistan and beyond. Its design and features position it as a reliable and effective antivirus solution capable of addressing the growing challenges posed by cyber threats. The insights offered here contribute to the broader conversation around developing advanced antivirus systems that can continuously adapt to the ever-changing landscape of cybersecurity, ensuring the safety of digital assets. (Abstract)

articleTitle: SonicVision: Navigating Object Counting Frontiers with Ultrasonic Economy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: Precise enumeration of mobile entities, encompassing both individuals and objects, remains a pivotal necessity in numerous sectors including, but not limited to, transportation, surveillance, retail and industrial automation. In this work, we thoroughly discuss the limitations and practical uses of several technologies presently involved in the task of counting moving objects. Following a comparative analysis, we argue for the use of ultrasonic sensing technology and opine that it is the best-suited option for proximal object counting scenarios owing to its economic viability and superior durability. Consequently, we propose a microcontroller-centric framework Sonic Vision, thereby facilitating the streamlined development of an ultrasonic sensing based counting system. To substantiate our proposition, a prototype system has also been developed that effectively counts objects moving on a conveyor belt, thus underpinning the theoretical precepts with empirical evidence. Furthermore, with a prospective lens, we envisage potential realms of application, articulating scenarios where the said system might find utility, hence forging a pathway for future investigative endeavours in this domain.

articleTitle: A Blockchain based E-Commerce Platform with Supply Chain Management and Authenticated Resale
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Innovations in Computer Science (ICONICS)
abstract: The E-commerce industry has seen significant growth over the past few years and many people prefer to purchase their goods online, but with this advancement and growth many fraudulent activities and scams have also gained a hike. Due to this the customers have shown significant concerns and worries while using any such platforms such as deception by vendors by selling fake products or their products getting counterfeit during the delivery process because the supply chain of their ordered product is often veiled in secrecy. This paper presents Commercio, a comprehensive solution that enables individuals with an understanding of how their products are transferred, managed, stored, and delivered to their doorsteps. Our application aims to tackle these challenges by creating an innovative e-commerce platform. This platform will serve as a dynamic marketplace and will connect sellers with customers who prioritize authenticity and dependability. Additionally, it will redefine supply chain management by offering unparalleled transparency and security. Moreover, incorporating blockchain-based payment systems will also improve transaction integrity hence delivering a trustworthy buying experience.
